title: Joshua Chapter 18 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Joshua chapter 18 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Joshua Chapter 18 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Joshua Chapter 18.

questions.question: Where did the whole congregation of the children of Israel assemble together?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:1 states that the whole congregation assembled at Shiloh.

questions.question: How many tribes of Israel had not yet received their inheritance at this time?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:2 mentions that seven tribes had not yet received their inheritance.

questions.question: What did Joshua ask the children of Israel about possessing the land?
options: How long are ye slack to go to possess the land?
When will you build the temple?
questions.correctAnswer: How long are ye slack to go to possess the land?
questions.explanation: In Joshua 18:3, Joshua asks how long they are slack to go possess the land given by God.

questions.question: How many men were to be given out from each tribe to describe the land?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:4 specifies that three men from each tribe were to go and describe the land.

questions.question: Into how many parts was the land to be divided according to Joshua 18?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:5 and 18:6 mention dividing the land into seven parts.

questions.question: Which tribe was to abide in their coast on the south?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:5 states that Judah shall abide in their coast on the south.

questions.question: Which tribe was to abide in their coast on the north?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:5 says the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.

questions.question: True or False: The Levites received a portion of the land among the children of Israel.
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:7 clarifies that the Levites have no part among the children of Israel because the priesthood is their inheritance.

questions.question: Which tribes had already received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east?
options: Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh
questions.correctAnswer: Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:7 states these tribes received their inheritance beyond Jordan east of the land.

questions.question: What command did Joshua give to the men who were sent to describe the land?
options: Go and walk through the land, describe it, and come again
Fight the inhabitants of the land
Stay at Shiloh and wait for instructions
questions.correctAnswer: Go and walk through the land, describe it, and come again
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:8 records Joshua charging the men to walk through the land, describe it, and return.

questions.question: True or False: The men described the land by cities into seven parts in a book.
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:9 confirms that the men passed through the land and described it by cities into seven parts in a book.

questions.question: Where did Joshua cast lots for the division of the land?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:10 states Joshua cast lots in Shiloh before the LORD to divide the land.

questions.question: True or False: Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions after casting lots.
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:10 explains that after casting lots, Joshua divided the land according to their divisions.

questions.question: In Joshua 18, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: Give out three men from each tribe to describe the land
Cast lots for the land division
Divide the land into seven parts
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:1 records the assembly at Shiloh before instructions about sending men or dividing land.

questions.question: True or False: The land was subdued before the children of Israel assembled at Shiloh.
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:1 states the land was subdued before them when they assembled at Shiloh.

medium.title: Joshua Chapter 18 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Joshua Chapter 18 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Joshua 18:11, between which tribes did the territory of Benjamin lie?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:11 states that the coast of Benjamin's lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph, indicating that Benjamin's inheritance was situated between these two tribes.

questions.question: What northern border is mentioned in Joshua 18:12 as part of Benjamin's territory?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:12 describes the northern border of Benjamin's territory beginning from Jordan and going up to the side of Jericho on the north side, outlining the northern limits of the inheritance.

questions.question: Which city is identified as Luz and also Bethel in Joshua 18:13?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:13 clarifies that Luz is the same city as Bethel, indicating the border went over toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel.

questions.question: How does Joshua 18:14 describe the western border of Benjamin's territory?
options: From the hill before Bethhoron southward around the corner of the sea
Along the Jordan River to the Dead Sea
From Jericho eastward to the wilderness
questions.correctAnswer: From the hill before Bethhoron southward around the corner of the sea
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:14 describes the western border as being drawn from the hill before Bethhoron southward, encompassing the corner of the sea, and reaching Kirjathbaal, a city of Judah.

questions.question: According to Joshua 18:15, where did the southern border of Benjamin's territory extend to?
options: The well of waters of Nephtoah
questions.correctAnswer: The well of waters of Nephtoah
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:15 says the south quarter of Benjamin's border went out from Kirjathjearim westward to the well of waters of Nephtoah, marking the southern extent.

questions.question: What valley near the mountain is part of Benjamin's border as described in Joshua 18:16?
options: Valley of the son of Hinnom
questions.correctAnswer: Valley of the son of Hinnom
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:16 states that the border came down to the mountain before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is part of Benjamin's southern boundary.

questions.question: Which landmark marks the northern extension of Benjamin's territory according to Joshua 18:17?
options: The stone of Bohan the son of Reuben
questions.correctAnswer: The stone of Bohan the son of Reuben
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:17 notes that the border was drawn toward the stone of Bohan, son of Reuben, marking a northern point in Benjamin's territory.

questions.question: Joshua 18:18 mentions Benjamin’s border going toward which region northward?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:18 describes the border passing along toward the side over against Arabah northward and then going down to Arabah itself.

questions.question: What does Joshua 18:19 say about the southern coast of Benjamin's inheritance?
options: It passed along to the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan
It extended to the Mediterranean Sea
It bordered the land of Edom
It included the city of Hebron
questions.correctAnswer: It passed along to the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:19 details that the southern coast extended to the north bay of the salt sea (Dead Sea) at the south end of Jordan, defining the southern border.

questions.question: According to Joshua 18:20, which natural feature defined the eastern border of Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:20 states that Jordan was the border on the east side for Benjamin's inheritance, clearly defining the eastern limit of their land.

questions.question: How does the description of Benjamin's cities in Joshua 18:21-28 demonstrate God's provision for the tribe?
options: By listing many cities providing a substantial inheritance
By assigning them no cities but only wilderness
By giving them only one city
By dividing their land equally with the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: By listing many cities providing a substantial inheritance
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:21-28 lists numerous cities and villages assigned to Benjamin, showing God’s faithfulness in providing a sizable and significant inheritance for the tribe.

questions.question: True or False: According to Joshua 18:11-20, the tribe of Benjamin's inheritance was surrounded by natural landmarks such as the Jordan River and the salt sea.
questions.explanation: Verses Joshua 18:11-20 describe Benjamin's borders as including the Jordan River on the east and the north bay of the salt sea on the south, showing the use of natural landmarks to define inheritance.

questions.question: What does Joshua 18:11-12 teach about the importance of diligence in possessing God's promises?
options: That God has already given the land, so the tribes must actively take possession
That the land will possess itself without any effort
That only some tribes will receive land
That the Levites will inherit land as priests
questions.correctAnswer: That God has already given the land, so the tribes must actively take possession
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:11-12 shows the clear division of land to Benjamin, emphasizing the need for the tribes to move forward and possess the land God gave them, reflecting the principle of faithful obedience.

questions.question: True or False: Joshua 18:16 indicates that the border of Benjamin's territory included the valley of giants and the valley of Hinnom.
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:16 explicitly mentions the border coming down to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of the giants on the north, confirming these valleys were part of Benjamin's border.

questions.question: If the tribes follow the instructions in Joshua 18:11-20 to carefully define their inheritance boundaries, what biblical virtue does this demonstrate?
questions.explanation: The careful and precise defining of the borders in Joshua 18:11-20 shows integrity and respect for God’s will in giving each tribe its portion, encouraging trust and obedience.

hard.title: Joshua Chapter 18 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Joshua Chapter 18.

questions.question: Which city mentioned in Joshua 18:28 is also known as Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:28 identifies 'Jebusi' as Jerusalem, stating 'Jebusi, which is Jerusalem.'

questions.question: How many cities with their villages made up the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to Joshua 18:28?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:28 states there were 'fourteen cities with their villages' for the inheritance of Benjamin.

questions.question: What was the eastern border of the tribe of Benjamin’s inheritance as described in Joshua 18:20?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:20 clearly states, 'Jordan was the border of it on the east side.'

questions.question: According to Joshua 18:21-24, which of the following cities was NOT part of the twelve cities with their villages in Benjamin's inheritance?
questions.explanation: Mizpeh is listed later in Joshua 18:26, not among the twelve cities in verses 21-24.

questions.question: What instruction did Joshua give to the men describing the land in Joshua 18:8?
options: Go and walk through the land, describe it, and return
Divide the land themselves by casting lots
questions.correctAnswer: Go and walk through the land, describe it, and return
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:8 records Joshua’s command to 'Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me.'

questions.question: In Joshua 18:7, which tribes are mentioned as having already received their inheritance beyond Jordan?
options: Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh
questions.correctAnswer: Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:7 states these tribes 'have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east.'

questions.question: What was the role of the Levites regarding the inheritance as per Joshua 18:7?
options: They had no part among the tribes because the priesthood was their inheritance
They shared equally with the tribe of Judah
They were given only cities but no land
questions.correctAnswer: They had no part among the tribes because the priesthood was their inheritance
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:7 explains 'the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance.'

questions.question: Which city listed in Joshua 18:25-26 is also known for being a significant prophetic site in later biblical history?
questions.explanation: Gibeon was significant as a Levitical city and prophetic center as referenced in later books like 1 Kings.

questions.question: True or False: According to Joshua 18:1, the tabernacle was set up at Shiloh after the land was subdued.
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:1 states the congregation assembled at Shiloh and set up the tabernacle there after the land was subdued.

questions.question: True or False: Joshua cast lots for the land division in Shiloh according to Joshua 18:10, fulfilling the practice established in Numbers 26:55.
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:10 records Joshua casting lots before the LORD at Shiloh, consistent with the Num 26:55 practice of allotting land by lot.

questions.question: Which literary device is exemplified by the detailed listing of cities in Joshua 18:21-28 reflecting the structure of tribal inheritance?
questions.explanation: The detailed city lists frame the inheritance, creating an inclusio that brackets and emphasizes the territory of Benjamin.

questions.question: Which Hebrew word meaning 'inheritance' is central to Joshua 18 and appears in the context of land division?
questions.explanation: 'Nachalah' (inheritance) is the Hebrew term used in Joshua 18 to describe the land portions given to the tribes.

questions.question: How does Joshua 18 link to the promise God made to Abraham about land possession in Genesis 15:18?
options: By describing the fulfillment of God's promise through land division
By introducing a new land promise for Israel
By focusing on the priesthood rather than land
questions.correctAnswer: By describing the fulfillment of God's promise through land division
questions.explanation: Joshua 18 details the actual distribution of the land promised to Abraham in Genesis 15:18, showing fulfillment of the covenant.

questions.question: What historical-cultural significance does the city of Jericho, mentioned in Joshua 18:21, have in Israel’s conquest narrative?
options: First city conquered by Israel under Joshua
City where the tabernacle was built
questions.correctAnswer: First city conquered by Israel under Joshua
questions.explanation: Jericho, listed in Joshua 18:21, was famously the first city Israel conquered (Joshua 6), marking the start of land possession.

questions.question: Which other biblical book also details the inheritance of the tribe of Benjamin, complementing Joshua 18's account?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8 provides genealogical and territorial details of Benjamin, complementing Joshua 18’s land allotment.

theological.title: Joshua Chapter 18 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Joshua Chapter 18 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Joshua 18:3 reveal about God's expectation for the Israelites regarding the possession of the land?
options: God expects immediate obedience to possess the land
God permits delay in taking possession of the land
God has not yet given the land to Israel
God leaves the decision to Joshua alone
questions.correctAnswer: God expects immediate obedience to possess the land
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:3 shows Joshua rebuking Israel for their delay, asking 'How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?' This indicates God's expectation for prompt obedience in claiming their inheritance.

questions.question: Which doctrine is taught by the Levites having no land inheritance according to Joshua 18:7?
options: The doctrine of the priesthood as a spiritual inheritance
The doctrine of universal land ownership
The doctrine of Levite exclusion from worship
The doctrine of tribal equality in land distribution
questions.correctAnswer: The doctrine of the priesthood as a spiritual inheritance
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:7 states 'But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance,' teaching that their spiritual role and priestly service is their true inheritance, not earthly land.

questions.question: How does the division of the land in Joshua 18:5-6 reflect God's sovereignty and justice?
options: God directs the equitable distribution by lot
God leaves the land to be divided by human power
God assigns land only to the strongest tribes
God allows the Levites to choose their inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: God directs the equitable distribution by lot
questions.explanation: Verses 5-6 describe dividing the land into seven parts and casting lots before the LORD, showing God's sovereign and just control over the fair allotment of the inheritance.

questions.question: What attribute of God is demonstrated by the assembly of the whole congregation and the setting up of the tabernacle at Shiloh in Joshua 18:1?
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:1 shows the whole congregation assembling and setting up the tabernacle, signifying God's manifest presence dwelling among His people, a key attribute of God.

questions.question: What theological insight can be drawn from Joshua 18:2 about the nature of God's promises and human responsibility?
options: God's promises require human action to be realized
God's promises are fulfilled regardless of human response
God's promises are conditional on perfect obedience
God's promises are only for certain tribes
questions.correctAnswer: God's promises require human action to be realized
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:2 notes seven tribes had not yet received their inheritance, highlighting that while God promises the land, human responsibility to possess it remains essential.

questions.question: How does Joshua 18:10 demonstrate God's providential guidance in the distribution of the land?
options: Joshua casting lots before the LORD ensures divine guidance
Joshua arbitrarily assigns land to tribes
The tribes negotiate land boundaries themselves
The land is divided according to tribal wealth
questions.correctAnswer: Joshua casting lots before the LORD ensures divine guidance
questions.explanation: Verse 10 shows Joshua casting lots 'before the LORD,' indicating God’s direct providence in ensuring a just and divinely ordained division of the inheritance.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal teaching do Joshua 18:4 and 18:8 convey about Christian stewardship and responsibility?
options: Believers are called to actively explore and claim their God-given inheritance
Believers are passive recipients of God's gifts
Only leaders have responsibility for God's promises
Land inheritance is secondary to spiritual matters
questions.correctAnswer: Believers are called to actively explore and claim their God-given inheritance
questions.explanation: Joshua 18:4 commands sending men to survey the land, and 18:8 repeats the charge to describe and report back so the land may be given by lot, emphasizing active responsibility in claiming God’s provision.

questions.question: How does the border description of Benjamin’s inheritance in Joshua 18:11-20 contribute to understanding the historical fulfillment of God's promises?
options: It shows the specificity and certainty of God’s covenant promises
It indicates uncertainty about tribal boundaries
It reflects human error in land division
questions.correctAnswer: It shows the specificity and certainty of God’s covenant promises
questions.explanation: The detailed borders in verses 11-20 demonstrate the precise fulfillment of God’s promises through concrete territory assigned to each tribe, affirming covenant faithfulness.

questions.question: What attribute of God is reflected in Joshua 18:28 by the inclusion of Jerusalem (Jebusi) in Benjamin’s inheritance?
questions.explanation: Jerusalem’s inclusion in Benjamin’s inheritance (18:28) foreshadows God’s providential preparation for the coming Messiah and redemptive history centered in that city.

questions.question: What theological synthesis arises from Joshua 18:1 and 18:10 about God’s covenantal faithfulness and order in the community?
options: God’s presence (tabernacle) and orderly land division (lots) ensure covenant fulfillment
God’s presence is independent of land possession
Covenants are fulfilled only by human effort
God’s faithfulness is conditional on the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: God’s presence (tabernacle) and orderly land division (lots) ensure covenant fulfillment
questions.explanation: Verse 1 shows God’s presence with Israel in Shiloh, while verse 10 shows God directing land division by casting lots, teaching that God’s covenant is fulfilled through His presence and ordered provision.

questions.question: What does Joshua 18:7 teach about the nature of spiritual inheritance compared to physical inheritance?
options: Spiritual inheritance (priesthood) supersedes physical land inheritance
Physical inheritance is more important than spiritual
Levites were excluded from any inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: Spiritual inheritance (priesthood) supersedes physical land inheritance
questions.explanation: The verse declares that Levites have no land inheritance because their priestly role is their true spiritual inheritance, indicating the primacy of spiritual blessings.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that the land division in Joshua 18 was arbitrary and lacked divine authority. What does Joshua 18:6-10 actually teach about the process?
options: The land was divided by casting lots before the LORD, indicating divine authority and order
The land was divided by popular vote among tribes
The land was divided by the strongest tribe’s choice
The division was random without any formal process
questions.correctAnswer: The land was divided by casting lots before the LORD, indicating divine authority and order
questions.explanation: Verses 6-10 describe the use of casting lots before the LORD to divide the land, showing God’s sovereign involvement and ensuring a just process, countering the sceptic’s claim.

questions.question: How does Joshua 18:21-28 contribute to the biblical theology of God’s faithfulness to tribal identities and promises?
options: It shows God’s faithfulness in preserving tribal distinctions through specific city allotments
It suggests tribes lost their identity after land division
It downplays the importance of tribal inheritances
It merges tribes into one indistinct group
questions.correctAnswer: It shows God’s faithfulness in preserving tribal distinctions through specific city allotments
questions.explanation: The listing of cities assigned to Benjamin’s tribe (18:21-28) highlights God’s faithfulness to maintain tribal identity and fulfill promises through precise allocations.

questions.question: What doctrinal insight about sanctification can be inferred from Joshua 18:4-9 regarding God’s call to His people?
options: Sanctification involves active exploration and claiming of God’s promises
Sanctification is passive waiting for blessings
Sanctification is limited to priests only
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctification involves active exploration and claiming of God’s promises
questions.explanation: The sending of men to survey and describe the land (18:4-9) teaches that sanctification includes diligent pursuit and taking hold of God’s promises, not passive acceptance.

questions.question: What narrative arc does Joshua 18:1 and 18:28 together illustrate in the grand story of redemption?
options: God’s presence established (tabernacle in Shiloh) and the preparation of the promised land as a setting for future redemption (Jerusalem in Benjamin’s inheritance)
The end of God’s covenantal promises
The failure of Israel to possess the land
questions.correctAnswer: God’s presence established (tabernacle in Shiloh) and the preparation of the promised land as a setting for future redemption (Jerusalem in Benjamin’s inheritance)
questions.explanation: Verse 1 shows God’s presence dwelling in Shiloh, while 18:28 includes Jerusalem in Benjamin’s land, foreshadowing the Messiah’s coming redemptive work within the promised land narrative.
